annotations.title: Get a script outline for a video

description: Returns an outline for the script of a video: the parts in order, their rough timing, how many spoken words fit, the two-column format and the rules for writing it. Use it when the user wants a script draft. You write the draft with the user from the outline, and it goes to Nikita with the brief (send_brief). It sends nothing.

length_seconds.description: Optional: the planned length in seconds, if the user knows it.

video_type.description: The kind of video, the same choices as plan_a_video.
